articles.summary: International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) (the “Company” or “INSW”) announced today that it plans to release third quarter 2026 results before market open on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The Company will host a conference call for investors at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time (“ET”) on the same day. Conference Call Details: Date: Thursday, November 5, 2026 Time 9:00 AM ET Dial-in Numbers United States: +1 (833) 461-5787 International: +1 (626) 884-3620 Conference ID 887 862 972 A live webcast of the conference call will be available from the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website at https://www.intlseas.com/ . Following the conclusion of the call, an audio replay will be available on the Events page of the Company’s website at www.intlseas.com/investor-relations/events-and-presentations until November 4, 2027. About International Seaways, Inc. International Seaways, Inc. (NYSE: INSW) is one of the largest public tanker companies in the world, providing seaborne transportation
articles.title: International Seaways to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 5, 2026
